done: Implemented NativeImportMode Append, Overwrite, and NewSpace as first-class import modes.
Added destructive overwrite confirmation enforcement in NativeImportRepository and Settings Import/export UI.
Added overwrite write-set semantics that clear the target space inside the import transaction before writing replacement records and import batch audit data.
Added stable new-space import mapping with imported space IDs and source-ID-prefixed records so reruns do not create uncontrolled duplicates.
Updated Settings Import/export UI state and AppShell wiring so mode selection is user-visible and dry-run/import calls use the selected mode.
Added repository tests for overwrite confirmation, overwrite replacement intent, new-space stability, and append rerun idempotency.
Integrated sidecar NATIVE-P4-004 data-backed export repository foundation for current-session and full-backup protocol JSON without exporting secrets.
Tightened UX task dependencies so NATIVE-UX-004 waits on Phase 4 foundations and NATIVE-UX-005 waits on Phase 5 Context/source foundations.
current_problem: NATIVE-P4-003 import modes and idempotency are implemented and locally verified. Phase 4 is still open because P4-004 Android share/save delivery, P4-006 first-launch prompt, and P4-007 device validation are not complete.
next_action: Finish NATIVE-P4-004 Android export share/save delivery and Settings export actions, then implement NATIVE-P4-006 first-launch import prompt before running NATIVE-P4-007 device validation.
must_keep_context: Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not call real LLM providers during automated or device smoke validation.
PWA/Capacitor remains transition/export source until Phase 6 and explicit approval.
Coverage registry remains conservative; P0 blockers are not reduced without full parity and device evidence.
NATIVE-P4-004 is only partly complete: protocol builders and data-backed export foundation are present, but Settings actions and Android share/save delivery remain open.
remaining_risks: P4-003 has local JVM/build validation but no device smoke for append/overwrite/new-space UI flows.
Overwrite clearing is scoped to the target space and import transaction, but destructive behavior still needs device validation in P4-007.
New-space idempotency uses a stable source-derived space identity; product may later choose an explicit duplicate-as-new-copy option, but uncontrolled duplicates are avoided for now.
P4-004 full-backup snapshot stores messages in the repository result, but the current protocol full-backup builder does not serialize messages yet.
UX-004 and UX-005 dependency gaps are corrected in task specs/execution plan, but their detailed layout acceptance criteria still need refinement before execution.
